title: Watch app noise smoothing
body:
Good morning. According to the documentation, "The watch app does not yet support Noise smoothing. Therefore, to confirm BG readings are consistently calculated on both phone and watch, it is best to turn off Noise Smoothing on the phone." Could this be solved? Is there a way to show the Alert sign on the watch so I know the readings have noise?
Thank you and regards
